InteractWithFaces_DriveForwardIdealDist_.blurb: Preferred drive-forward distance (mm) during InteractWithFaces when the memory-map ray is clear (default 40).

InteractWithFaces_DriveForwardMinDist_mm.blurb: Fallback drive distance (mm) when memory-map check fails / collides; can be negative (default -15).

InteractWithFaces_DoGlanceDown.blurb: If true (and memory-map check enabled), dip head to -10° before driving forward (default false).

InteractWithFaces_DoMemoryMapCheckForDri.blurb: If true, ray-check nav map for collisions over ideal dist and pick ideal vs min drive; if false always use ideal (default true).

InteractWithFaces_VizMemoryMapCheck.blurb: Draw Viz segment for the drive-forward collision ray (yellow=collision, blue=clear).

InteractWithFaces_DriveForwardSpeed_mmps.blurb: Speed (mm/s) for the DriveStraight during face interaction approach (default 40).

InteractWithFaces_MinTrackingPanAngle_de.blurb: Min pan tolerance (deg) for TrackFaceAction during TrackingFace state so small turns still animate life (default 4). Not used on the head-only drive phase (that uses behavior JSON).

InteractWithFaces_MinTrackingTiltAngle_d.blurb: Min tilt tolerance (deg) for TrackFaceAction during TrackingFace state (default 4). Drive-forward head track uses instance JSON instead.

Wiggle_ForwardDist_mm.blurb: Forward wiggle distance (mm) when re-seating on charger contacts (default 6). Group label is Behavior.InteractWithFaces (copy-paste).

Wiggle_ForwardSpeed_mmps.blurb: Forward wiggle speed (mm/s) onto charger contacts (default 120).

Wiggle_BackupDist_mm.blurb: Backup distance (mm) first step of charger-contact wiggle (default 15; DriveStraight uses -dist).

Wiggle_VerifyWaitTime_s.blurb: Wait (s) after hitting contacts before verifying still on charger (default 0.25).

Wiggle_BackupSettleTime_s.blurb: While backing up, keep driving this long (s) after first contact before verify (default 0.4).

ReactToHand_DriveDistanceFraction.blurb: Fraction of prox distance_mm used as DriveStraight distance toward hand (0–1, default 1).

ReactToHand_PitchAngleThresh_deg.blurb: Pitch rise (deg) from activate that counts as robot-lifted-on-hand; skips lift reaction path (default 3).

ReactToMotion_ticksInIntervalForTurn.blurb: Per-instance tunable: motion ticks in history interval before turning toward motion (MakeMemberTunable → ReactToMotion_*). ANKI_DEV_CHEATS only.

ReactToMotion_procHeadAngle_deg.blurb: Procedural-mode head angle (deg) when turning toward Top motion area; only loaded/used if behavior JSON procedural=true.

ReactToMotion_procTurnAngle_deg.blurb: Procedural-mode body turn magnitude (deg) for Left/Right motion (signed by side); requires procedural=true in config.

ReactToMotion_eyeTimeout_s.blurb: Seconds without motion in looked-at area before exiting eye-tracking (also used after turn wait).

ReactToMotion_eyeShiftTimeout_s.blurb: Seconds without motion in current look direction before shifting eyes to another motion area (must be ≤ eyeTimeout).
